result.definition: 按退货事件时间统计有退货记录的不同订单，每个当前品类内去重；跨品类不可相加。
result.sql: SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM dwd.return_record_fact AS f JOIN dim.product AS p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE f.returned_at >= %(start)s AND f.returned_at < %(end)s GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY category_id LIMIT %(row_limit)s
